description: Agent Learning: submit lesson records to read for whether raw experience was distilled into stated, general lessons: each lesson with its id, the lesson as stated, read for wording tied to one event such as yesterday, a date, a ticket number or I sent, the ids of the episodes it was drawn from, the raw log it came from, compared with the statement, the situation it applies in, and what to do differently in that situation. The signed report gives every lesson with its statement, the one-event wording read from it, whether it repeats its log and its status as distilled, unstated, copied, event_bound, no_condition, no_action or unconfirmed, counts the lessons distilled, left raw, with a situation and with an action, and lists every one-event word found, and names lessons left as raw experience: lessons with no statement of their own, statements that repeat the log they came from, and statements that read as an account of one event rather than a general lesson; then lessons that state no situation they apply in and lessons that state nothing to do differently, with the fix for each. This reads lessons distilled from the agent’s own experience: one stored knowledge entry read for its source, date, scope and review is wever_knowledge-entry-check, and which stores hold run state and cross-session memory is wever_memory-design-check. Verdict lessons_still_raw, distillation_partial, no_distillation or lessons_distilled. POST /api/learning-distillation-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

action.description: What to do differently in that situation.

applies_when.description: The situation it applies in, such as when a refund names an order placed before a card change.

episodes.description: The ids of the episodes it was drawn from.

id.description: The lesson id, such as l1.

log.description: The raw log it was drawn from, compared with the statement.

statement.description: The lesson as stated, read for wording tied to one event such as yesterday, a date or a ticket number.

name: wever_learning-distillation-check
title: Learning distillation check
